title: Seaside 640 "Suite Magnolia I" Forest Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach, community pools, and amenities- Steps from the famous Seaside Town Square featuring plenty of shopping and dining- Charcoal grill- 2 adult bikes- 1 dedicated parking spot- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Welcome to Suite Magnolia I, a lovely Seaside home with 2 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms that accommodates 4 guests. Known for its picturesque and walkable streets, Seaside is a beach lover’s paradise with charming local restaurants, boutiques, and community pools alongside a family-friendly atmosphere. Guests will love this home’s multiple outdoor spaces and the quick walk to the beach!An expansive front porch with a bench swing and a charcoal grill off the walking path greets guests upon arrival at this 2-story home. Inside, a cool color palette and hardwood floors stretch throughout the home to create a soothing and comfortable environment. There are 2 bedrooms on the bottom floor with queen beds and private bathrooms.Guests will find a bright living space and combined eat-in kitchen filled with natural light upstairs. Spend a sunny morning making breakfast to share at the 6-person table. In the living area, 2 Spring green couches and an armchair surround the TV and provide a cozy place to unwind from a day of beach fun. There are 3 glass double doors that open to the covered balcony with rocking chairs and a wicker table for 4—the perfect spot to savor an evening cocktail.Enjoy a delightful and relaxing vacation at Suite Magnolia I in Seaside. Parking for 1 vehicle and 2 complimentary adult bikes makes exploring the area and nearby Scenic 30A neighborhoods easy. Book this beach home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENT (Sleeps 4):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Living Area: Kitchen, Living Room, Dining Room and Half Bathroom*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Unfortunately, the HOA in this community prohibits Low-Speed Vehicle rentals or for guests to bring their own.*Your rental property may share a courtyard, porch, or lot with another unit that is owner-occupied or rented to separate guests from your party.
